## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Tests are in this change, and `make ci` passes locally
- [ ] No real company data, credentials, hostnames or employer names
- [ ] No new dependency, or it was approved in an issue first
- [ ] No new scanner suppression, or it has a reason and an expiry (ADR-0005)
- [ ] Docs, ADRs and the threat model are updated if behavior or trust boundaries changed
